# Prime POS

> Prime POS is an all-in-one business management platform — point-of-sale, inventory, accounting, HRM, warranty, CMS and business intelligence — built for retailers and SaaS teams. Mobile-first, multi-tenant, and runs on Lovable Cloud.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, pricing, FAQs and customer reviews.
- [Sign in](/login): Sign in to manage your business workspace.
- [Register](/register): Create a new business account and start a free trial.

## Optional

- [Subscription](/subscription): Manage your Prime POS subscription and billing.
